sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是香卡·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: Whenever a group of people come together, there are always a few who steal the limelight.
sentences.zh: 每当一群人聚在一起，总有那么几个人会抢尽风头。

sentences.en: They may be gregarious and outgoing, or funnier, or more athletic.
sentences.zh: 他们可能生性社交、外向、更有趣，或者更有运动天赋。

sentences.en: But I've noticed over the years that the people who are the center of attention on day one
sentences.zh: 但我多年来注意到，那些在第一天成为关注焦点的人

sentences.en: are very often not the center of their groups by day 62, or day 912.
sentences.zh: 往往在第62天或第912天时，就不再是群体的中心了。

sentences.en: This is true of college students, new employees at a company, even family.
sentences.zh: 大学生、公司新员工，甚至家庭都是如此。

sentences.en: Over time, the accomplished musician turns out to be a one-note opera.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，才华横溢的音乐家结果却成了只会单曲循环的歌剧。

sentences.en: The athlete who dazzled on day one starts to sound boring.
sentences.zh: 第一天惊艳全场的运动员开始显得索然无味。

sentences.en: The great storyteller turns out he has only a dozen stories, and he keeps telling them over and over again.
sentences.zh: 那个伟大的说书人结果也只有十几段故事，而且还在不断地翻来覆去地讲。

sentences.en: In time, groups often gravitate to the people who are connectors,
sentences.zh: 久而久之，群体往往会被那些具有连接能力的人所吸引，

sentences.en: the folks who are genuinely interested in others.
sentences.zh: 也就是那些真正对他人感兴趣的人。

sentences.en: They are often great listeners.
sentences.zh: 他们通常都是出色的倾听者。

sentences.en: These are people who put others first, who don't imagine they know everything.
sentences.zh: 这些人总是把别人放在第一位，从不自以为无所不知。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, and in a companion story on our subscription feed, Hidden Brain Plus,
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》节目，以及我们订阅频道《隐藏的大脑+》上的配套故事中，

sentences.en: we examine the science and psychology of humility.
sentences.zh: 我们将探讨谦逊的科学与心理学。

sentences.en: It's a quality that is often underappreciated on day one, but much in demand over the long haul.
sentences.zh: 这是一种在第一天常常被低估，但在长远来看却备受需求的品质。

sentences.en: And while most of us don't associate humble people with being particularly brave,
sentences.zh: 虽然我们大多数人并不把谦逊的人与特别勇敢联系在一起，

sentences.en: new scientific research shows that humility usually walks hand in hand with courage.
sentences.zh: 但新的科学研究表明，谦逊通常与勇气并存。

sentences.en: Many people have the experience of growing up in one set of circumstances,
sentences.zh: 许多人都曾经历过在某种特定环境下长大，

sentences.en: and then finding themselves in a different set of circumstances as they grow up and start life on their own.
sentences.zh: 然后在长大成人并开始独立生活时，发现自己身处另一种截然不同的环境之中。

sentences.en: If that's a familiar story to you, you also know what it's like to go back to the old family home,
sentences.zh: 如果你对这种经历并不陌生，你也一定知道回到老家、

sentences.en: the old neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 回到旧时的街区是什么感觉。

sentences.en: They haven't changed much.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有多大改变。

sentences.en: But you?
sentences.zh: 但你呢？

sentences.en: You find yourself miles apart, maybe galaxies apart, from the folks you knew as a kid.
sentences.zh: 你会发现自己与儿时认识的人相隔万里，甚至像是隔了几个银河系。

sentences.en: How do you respond to this?
sentences.zh: 你该如何应对？

sentences.en: Do you go back to being the old you, who fits in?
sentences.zh: 你是变回那个随波逐流的老自己？

sentences.en: Or the new you, who doesn't?
sentences.zh: 还是变成那个格格不入的新自己？

sentences.en: Daryl Van Tongeren is a psychologist at Hope College in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 达里尔·范·通格伦是密歇根州霍普学院的一名心理学家。

sentences.en: He experienced this schism after he left his family home in Southern California
sentences.zh: 在离开南加州的家乡

sentences.en: and went off to college and graduate school.
sentences.zh: 去上大学和读研究生之后，他也经历过这种裂痕。

sentences.en: Daryl Van Tongeren, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 达里尔·范·通格伦，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Tell me a little bit about your family of origin, Daryl.
sentences.zh: 达里尔，能跟我讲讲你的原生家庭吗？

sentences.en: I understand you grew up in a conservative Christian household?
sentences.zh: 据我了解，你是在一个保守的基督徒家庭长大的？

sentences.en: I did, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: So growing up, I grew up in a working class family.
sentences.zh: 我是在一个工人阶级家庭长大的。

sentences.en: My mom immigrated from the Netherlands when she was 10 or 11,
sentences.zh: 我妈妈10岁或11岁时从荷兰移民过来，

sentences.en: married my dad, who was a heavy diesel mechanic for Los Angeles County.
sentences.zh: 嫁给了我爸爸，他曾是洛杉矶县的一名重型柴油机机械师。

sentences.en: And really, the focus on my family was a lot about being together.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我家庭的重心很大程度上在于聚在一起。

sentences.en: We were a deeply religious family, very conservative,
sentences.zh: 我们是一个笃信宗教的家庭，非常保守，

sentences.en: and really highly prioritized practical things.
sentences.zh: 并且高度重视实际的事情。

sentences.en: My dad was avid about cars and loved working on his cars.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸对汽车非常狂热，喜欢摆弄他的车。

sentences.en: Did he spend a lot of time tinkering in his spare time?
sentences.zh: 他在业余时间花了很多时间捣鼓汽车吗？

sentences.en: It sounds like he was working with his hands during his day job,
sentences.zh: 听起来他不仅在正职上用双手工作，

sentences.en: but also with his hands in his spare time.
sentences.zh: 在业余时间也用双手工作。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 千真万确。

sentences.en: So he had this prized possession, this 1972 Chevelle Supersport,
sentences.zh: 他有一个珍爱的宝贝，那是一辆1972年的雪佛兰Super Sport，

sentences.en: any time he could, holidays, weekends.
sentences.zh: 只要一有时间，不管是假期还是周末。

sentences.en: He was always tinkering on that car, trying to get it just right.
sentences.zh: 他总是围着那辆车修修补补，试图把它调校到最完美的状态。

sentences.en: Did he try and get his kids engaged in his passion?
sentences.zh: 他有没有试图让他的孩子们也参与到他的爱好中？

sentences.en: He did.
sentences.zh: 他试过。

sentences.en: Sadly for him, with not much success.
sentences.zh: 但对他的遗憾的是，并没有取得多大成功。

sentences.en: So we didn't share his same passion for that car.
sentences.zh: 所以我们并没有分享他对那辆车的同等热情。

sentences.en: Darrell and his siblings had other interests.
sentences.zh: 达里尔和他的兄弟姐妹们有别的兴趣。

sentences.en: They were all bookish in their own ways.
sentences.zh: 他们用各自的方式展现出书卷气。

sentences.en: They all went on to college, the first in their immediate family to do so.
sentences.zh: 他们都上了大学，是直系亲属中第一批上大学的人。

sentences.en: Darrell continued on to graduate school.
sentences.zh: 达里尔继续攻读研究生。

sentences.en: And as he became highly educated,
sentences.zh: 随着他接受了高等教育，

sentences.en: he felt more and more removed from his working class roots.
sentences.zh: 他感到自己与工人阶级根源的距离越来越远。

sentences.en: It was challenging in many regards.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，这都是个挑战。

sentences.en: When I went to graduate school, I felt out of place because I was in situations and with people
sentences.zh: 当我读研究生时，我感到很不自在，因为我身处的环境和接触的人

sentences.en: who were much more educated than my family was.
sentences.zh: 比我的家人受过更高的教育。

sentences.en: We would be at cocktail parties talking about things we had read and presumably sharing experiences
sentences.zh: 我们会在鸡尾酒会上谈论读过的事物，并自以为分享着

sentences.en: we thought we all had as children that I didn't have.
sentences.zh: 我们以为每个人都有过的童年经历，而我其实并没有。

sentences.en: And then going back home, I felt like I couldn't fit in either because here I was trying to be
sentences.zh: 然后回到家后，我也觉得无法融入，因为我在这里试图成为

sentences.en: this budding intellectual, cultivated life of the mind.
sentences.zh: 一个初出茅庐的知识分子，追求精神层面的文化生活。

sentences.en: And it was much more pragmatic.
sentences.zh: 而家里要实用得多。

sentences.en: And let's talk about the car or let's talk about sports.
sentences.zh: 我们要聊聊车或者聊聊体育。

sentences.en: And so I always felt kind of caught in between.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是觉得自己有点夹在中间进退维谷。

sentences.en: Darrell tried to interest his dad in the things he was reading and learning.
sentences.zh: 达里尔曾试图让他的父亲对他的阅读和学习内容产生兴趣。

sentences.en: And I asked him, hey, you know, what if we read something?
sentences.zh: 我问他，嘿，你看，如果我们读点东西怎么样？

sentences.en: You read something, I'll read it.
sentences.zh: 你读点什么，我也读点什么。

sentences.en: We'll kind of connect on that.
sentences.zh: 我们可以就此进行交流。

sentences.en: And he kind of said without missing a beat, you know, Darrell,
sentences.zh: 他不假思索地对我说，你知道吗，达里尔，

sentences.en: I literally have no interest in reading whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 我 literalmente（根本）对阅读毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: And I think at that moment, I felt this condescension.
sentences.zh: 我想在那一刻，我感受到了这种屈尊俯就。

sentences.en: And I felt this, you know, holier-than-thou attitude.
sentences.zh: 我还感受到了那种，你知道的，高人一等的态度。

sentences.en: Like, how could you not have any interest in reading?
sentences.zh: 心想：你怎么会一点阅读兴趣都没有呢？

sentences.en: And I probably rolled my eyes to hold back some of my contempt.
sentences.zh: 我大概还翻了个白眼，好掩饰我内心的一些轻蔑。

sentences.en: And that's when I really felt that difference.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时，我真正感受到了那种差异。

sentences.en: In time, Darrell came to see that he was part of the problem.
sentences.zh: 一段时间后，达里尔开始意识到自己也是问题的一部分。

sentences.en: When he looked down on his dad for not being interested in books,
sentences.zh: 当他因为父亲对书本不感兴趣而看不起他时，

sentences.en: his own disdain placed a barrier between them.
sentences.zh: 他自己的不屑在两人之间筑起了一道屏障。

sentences.en: I think one of the things that I was doing that was impeding my relationship was
sentences.zh: 我想我当时阻碍我们关系的一个做法就是，

sentences.en: I was really failing to take his perspective.
sentences.zh: 我真的没有站在他的角度去考虑问题。

sentences.en: So I was really centering, what's going on in my life?
sentences.zh: 所以我完全以自我为中心：我生活里发生了什么？

sentences.en: I'm the one feeling hurt.
sentences.zh: 我是那个受到伤害的人。

sentences.en: Why doesn't he understand me?
sentences.zh: 为什么他不能理解我？

sentences.en: And not imagining, I wonder what it's like for my dad to have someone move far away.
sentences.zh: 却没有去想，我的爸爸看到有人搬到远方去，心里会是什么滋味。

sentences.en: The rest of his kids were right there living in the same town.
sentences.zh: 他的其他孩子都住在同一个镇上。

sentences.en: Here I am.
sentences.zh: 而我呢。

sentences.en: I've left.
sentences.zh: 我已经离开了。

sentences.en: I'm on the East CoaSt.
sentences.zh: 我在东海岸。

sentences.en: Maybe he's feeling a little intimidated because he never graduated from college.
sentences.zh: 也许他会觉得有点自卑，因为他从未上过大学。

sentences.en: And here I am with an advanced degree.
sentences.zh: 而我却拥有高等学位。

sentences.en: Are there ways that I'm speaking down to him?
sentences.zh: 我是不是在用居高临下的语气跟他说话？

sentences.en: I'm acting in a condescending way.
sentences.zh: 我的行为表现得是否有些傲慢？

sentences.en: And really failing to appreciate and take his perspective.
sentences.zh: 我确实没能体谅和理解他的立场。

sentences.en: And once I realized that I had a part to play,
sentences.zh: 一旦我意识到自己也有责任，

sentences.en: I had to own up and take responsibility for what I was contributing to that relationship.
sentences.zh: 我就必须正视并承担起我对这段关系所带来的负面影响。

sentences.en: It was only then that we could start making a turn into something better.
sentences.zh: 直到那时，我们才开始向更好的方向转变。

sentences.en: Daryl went on to become a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 达里尔后来成为了一名心理学家。

sentences.en: He started to study humility.
sentences.zh: 他开始研究谦逊。

sentences.en: But as the years passed, he noticed that it was one thing to learn about humility
sentences.zh: 但随着岁月流逝，他发现了解谦逊是一回事，

sentences.en: and another to practice it.
sentences.zh: 而践行谦逊则是另一回事。

sentences.en: One time, he was being interviewed by a reporter
sentences.zh: 有一次，他接受了一名记者的采访，

sentences.en: who asked him an interesting question that involved Daryl's wife, Sarah.
sentences.zh: 记者问了他一个有趣的问题，牵涉到达里尔的妻子莎拉。

sentences.en: Yeah, so this reporter was covering some of my recent research
sentences.zh: 是的，当时这位记者正在报道我最近关于

sentences.en: on humility within romantic relationships.
sentences.zh: 亲密关系中谦逊的研究。

sentences.en: And she said, you know, I'm kind of curious, you know,
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道的，我有点好奇，

sentences.en: because you're someone who studies humility, you know,
sentences.zh: 因为你是一个研究谦逊的人，

sentences.en: how do you fare in your romantic relationship?
sentences.zh: 你在自己的亲密关系中表现如何？

sentences.en: You know, would your partner consider you,
sentences.zh: 你的伴侣会认为你……

sentences.en: how humble would your partner consider you to be?
sentences.zh: 你的伴侣会认为你有多谦逊？

sentences.en: So she said, you know, would you mind asking your wife how humble you are?
sentences.zh: 于是她说，你介意问问你妻子你有多谦逊吗？

sentences.en: So, oh, so happy.
sentences.zh: 哦，当时我太高兴了。

sentences.en: You know, I'm so excited to go collect the data
sentences.zh: 我太兴奋了，急着去收集数据，

sentences.en: and prove to the reporter and the rest of the world
sentences.zh: 向记者和全世界证明，

sentences.en: that obviously someone who studies humility,
sentences.zh: 一个研究谦逊的人，

sentences.en: must be extremely humble.
sentences.zh: 显然必定极其谦逊。

sentences.en: So I come upstairs from this interview from the basement
sentences.zh: 于是我从地下室的采访现场走到楼上，

sentences.en: and I say, Sarah, on a scale of one to 10,
sentences.zh: 我说：莎拉，在一到十的范围内，

sentences.en: how humble would you rate me?
sentences.zh: 你觉得我的谦逊程度能打几分？

sentences.en: And she says, one to 10, I think I'd rate you a four.
sentences.zh: 她说：一到十的话，我觉得我给你打四分。

sentences.en: And so I'm crestfallen because I think, oh gosh, a four,
sentences.zh: 我顿时大失所望，心想：天哪，四分，

sentences.en: you know, that's below the midpoint.
sentences.zh: 这可是低于中间值啊。

sentences.en: And then she says, well, wait a minute, is one high or low?
sentences.zh: 然后她说：等等，一分是高还是低？

sentences.en: So for a moment, I think, well, maybe she misunderstood
sentences.zh: 有一瞬间我想，也许她误会了，

sentences.en: and I'll still be above the midpoint.
sentences.zh: 那我应该还是高于中间值吧。

sentences.en: I say, no, one is low and 10 is high.
sentences.zh: 我说：不，一分是低，十分是高。

sentences.en: And she goes, yeah, four.
sentences.zh: 然后她说：对啊，四分。

sentences.en: Yeah, you're just a four.
sentences.zh: 没错，你就是四分。

sentences.en: I'm wondering if you asked her how she reached this conclusion, Daryl.
sentences.zh: 达里尔，我想知道你有没有问过她是怎么得出这个结论的。

sentences.en: Obviously, this was very different from your own conclusion of yourself.
sentences.zh: 很显然，这与你对自己的看法大相径庭。

sentences.en: I immediately got defensive about why she would, you know, rate me as a four.
sentences.zh: 我立刻开始为她为什么会给我打四分进行辩解。

sentences.en: And she, you know, kind of quickly pointed out that, you know,
sentences.zh: 而她则很快指出，

sentences.en: this was a day where we had promised to go to the beach.
sentences.zh: 那天本来是我们承诺要去海滩的日子。

sentences.en: We were, I promised that we would leave for the beach no later than 11.
sentences.zh: 我曾答应过她，我们最迟在11点出发去海滩。

sentences.en: But even knowing that, I took an interview at 10 a.m.
sentences.zh: 但明知如此，我还是接了一个上午10点的采访。

sentences.en: And I assured her it'll be 15 minutes tops.
sentences.zh: 我还向她保证，顶多也就15分钟。

sentences.en: Well, this interview drug on, you know, 75, almost 90 minutes.
sentences.zh: 结果这个采访拖了75分钟，差不多90分钟。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So we're running late.
sentences.zh: 所以我们时间就来不及了。

sentences.en: My wife has already packed the lunches.
sentences.zh: 我妻子已经打包好了午餐。

sentences.en: She's packed the towels, packed the reading material.
sentences.zh: 她收拾好了毛巾，收拾好了阅读材料。

sentences.en: She's ready to go to the beach.
sentences.zh: 她已经准备好去海滩了。

sentences.en: I finally come up.
sentences.zh: 我终于上楼来。

sentences.en: We're already running late, wasting precious sunshine, parking spots.
sentences.zh: 我们已经迟到了，正在浪费宝贵的阳光和停车位。

sentences.en: And then, before I even ask her to rate me, I say, you know,
sentences.zh: 然后，甚至在我请她给我打分之前，我说，你知道的，

sentences.en: would you mind driving the stuff out there to the beach?
sentences.zh: 你介意把东西开车送到海滩那边吗？

sentences.en: I'd like to run to the beach because I'm training for a marathon.
sentences.zh: 我想去海滩跑步，因为我在为马拉松做准备。

sentences.en: I need to get a run in today.
sentences.zh: 我今天得跑跑步。

sentences.en: And the beach is about seven miles away, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且海滩大概有七英里远，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I was thinking about a seven-mile run is what I was going to put in anyway.
sentences.zh: 我本来就打算跑个七英里左右。

sentences.en: So would you mind, you know, after all that you've done,
sentences.zh: 所以你介意，你知道的，在你做了这一切之后，

sentences.en: going the extra mile and taking it all out to the beach?
sentences.zh: 再多走一步，把所有东西都带到海滩去吗？

sentences.en: And I'll just meet you down there after I get my run in.
sentences.zh: 等我跑完步，就在那边跟你们汇合。

sentences.en: So looking back, four was probably a pretty gracious and compassionate response.
sentences.zh: 所以回想起来，四分可能是一个相当宽容和富有同情心的回应。

sentences.en: It was probably higher than I deserved at the moment.
sentences.zh: 这可能比我当时应得的分数要高。

sentences.en: And, of course, at that point, you didn't quite see it, right?
sentences.zh: 当然，在那个时候，你并没有完全看清，对吧？

sentences.en: You hadn't quite sort of seen the context when you came up the stairs and asked her
sentences.zh: 当你走上楼梯并问她时，你并没有完全看清当时的情境，

sentences.en: because you obviously expected her to give you an eight or a nine.
sentences.zh: 因为你显然期望她给你打八分或九分。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: It was still lost on me.
sentences.zh: 我当时还是没有领会到。

sentences.en: We sampled people who were in these ongoing romantic relationships

sentences.en: how satisfied, how much do you forgive your partner.

sentences.en: And because of that commitment, they reported being more satisfied in their relationship
